en_title: GTA 6 Players Are Optimizing the Money Glitch to Within an Inch of Its Life to Make $100,000 in Just 10 Minutes
cn_title: 《GTA 6》玩家将刷钱漏洞的效率压榨到极致，只需10分钟就能赚取100,000美元
opus_summary: 《GTA 6》玩家发现了一种利用厢式货车和角色切换复制战利品的刷钱方法。据一名在Reddit发帖的玩家称，该方法不到10分钟可赚取8.8万至10万美元(约合人民币67万元)。Rockstar尚未在游戏发售后的首个补丁中处理此类漏洞。

paragraphs.en: We’ve already covered players using infinite money glitches to get rich quickly in GTA 6 , but people are taking it to the next level. New money-making optimization strategies are seeing players become millionaires in a couple of hours, while still in the early game.
paragraphs.cn: 我们此前报道过玩家在《GTA 6》中利用无限刷钱漏洞快速致富，但人们正将其提升到新的水平。新的赚钱优化策略让玩家在游戏初期就能于几小时内成为百万富翁。

paragraphs.en: Instead of playing the game as intended and robbing stores, banks, and gang hideouts, some GTA 6 players are repeating the same actions over and over to generate money fast.
paragraphs.cn: 一些《GTA 6》玩家没有按照游戏预期的方式抢劫商店、银行和帮派据点，而是一遍又一遍地重复相同的操作来快速赚钱。

paragraphs.en: The new method sees players using vans and character swaps at a location in a town called Hamlet. In Hamlet, there’s an industrial area with a big warehouse outside of town, with a teddy bear van parked outside.
paragraphs.cn: 这种新方法需要玩家在一座名为Hamlet的小镇的某个地点使用厢式货车并切换角色。Hamlet镇外有一个工业区，那里有一座大仓库，外面停着一辆泰迪熊厢式货车。

paragraphs.en: There are drugs inside the van outside as well as inside the warehouse itself. To do the glitch, you need to register two vans, turn up to the location, and have your partner call in a different personal vehicle while the player calls in one of the personal vans and takes the loot.
paragraphs.cn: 外面的厢式货车和仓库里都有毒品。要利用这个漏洞，你需要登记两辆厢式货车，来到该地点，让搭档呼叫另一辆个人载具，同时玩家呼叫其中一辆个人厢式货车并拿取战利品。

paragraphs.en: Stow the loot in the back of your personal vehicle, then drive the teddy van parked outside into the warehouse, parking it inside, on the right of the door, at which point tell your partner to wait in the car. The player then gets out and drives the teddy bear van parked inside (both of these vans are empty of loot at this point) and park this opposite the other van, so both vans have their back doors facing the shutter entrance.
paragraphs.cn: 将战利品放进你的个人载具后部，然后把停在外面的泰迪熊厢式货车开进仓库，停在门内右侧，接着让搭档在车里等候。玩家随后下车，驾驶停在仓库内的泰迪熊厢式货车（此时这两辆厢式货车里都没有战利品），把它停在另一辆厢式货车对面，让两辆车的后门都朝向卷帘门入口。

paragraphs.en: Next, switch to your partner and exit the first teddy van before heading outside, where you switch back. Then ask your partner to drive the personal van loaded with all the loot. Using the partner menu, ask your partner to fence the loot, and watch them drive off to do so.
paragraphs.cn: 接下来，切换到搭档，让其离开第一辆泰迪熊厢式货车，走到外面后再切换回来。然后让搭档驾驶装满所有战利品的个人厢式货车。通过搭档菜单，让搭档销赃，然后看着搭档开车离去。

paragraphs.en: Once your partner has driven off, use the Scooter Bros app to call in the second personal van. After backing the van up to the warehouse, switch to the partner fencing the loot, before immediately switching back. This respawns both teddy bear vans and the loot inside, but it also keeps the two you moved earlier where you parked them inside and fills them with loot, essentially doubling the take.
paragraphs.cn: 搭档开车离开后，使用Scooter Bros应用呼叫第二辆个人厢式货车。将车倒到仓库门口后，切换到正在销赃的搭档，然后立即切换回来。这样会让两辆泰迪熊厢式货车及其中的战利品重新生成，同时你先前移动车辆仍会留在仓库内的停车位置，并装满战利品，实际上让收获翻了一倍。

paragraphs.en: According to one GTA 6 player who posted about this new method on Reddit , the technique earns you between $88,000-$100,000 in under 10 minutes.
paragraphs.cn: 据一位在Reddit上发帖介绍这一新方法的《GTA 6》玩家称，这种技巧能让你在不到10分钟内赚取88,000至100,000美元。

paragraphs.en: Some of the replies to the Reddit post asked the OP when their in-game bank account limit will be raised, suggesting they’re still relatively early in the game. Later on, more lucrative robbery opportunities open up for players anyway, and you can pull off $100k jobs with way less hassle than this, and while having some actual fun whilst you’re at it.
paragraphs.cn: Reddit帖子下的一些回复询问原帖作者，其游戏内银行账户的限额何时会提高，这表明他们的游戏进度可能还比较靠前。到了后期，玩家本来也会有收益更高的抢劫机会，可以用远比这省事的方式完成价值100,000美元的任务，还能在过程中真正获得一些乐趣。

paragraphs.en: The question is whether Rockstar patches early days money glitches like these out of GTA 6. GTA 6's first post-launch patch failed to take action, but I imagine it won't be long before Rockstar does something about this.
paragraphs.cn: 问题在于，Rockstar是否会通过补丁从《GTA 6》中移除这些早期刷钱漏洞。《GTA 6》发售后的首个补丁没有采取行动，但我想Rockstar用不了多久就会对此有所作为。

If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips , Chapter 2 Guide and Tips , and Chapter 3 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA 6》，或者不知道接下来该做什么？来IGN查看《GTA 6》官方指南吧。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过《新手指南——67条提示与技巧》了解《侠盗猎车手》的新系统，或者查阅《第1章指南与提示》、《第2章指南与提示》和《第3章指南与提示》，了解最初几个章节的全部细节。如果你已经开车游遍Leonida，想知道所有可以发现和进行的内容，请查看Leonida互动地图。
